remaining_gaps: Do not mark the subject expert-complete from portal or research-repository coverage alone.
Foundation-level nanomedicine, self-assembly, computational nanoscience, and nano-safety teaching may remain thinner than specialist coverage.
Expert readiness requires runtime retrieval tests, item-level evidence evaluation, practical assessment, safety controls, and provenance.
